text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS

- ETA member Eugenio Etxebeste, alias Antxon, who was expelled from the Dominican Republic to Spain on Saturday, refused to mediate to avoid assassination of Basque town councillor Miguel Angel Blanco.
EL MUNDO

- Ignacio Aracama Mendia, alias Macario, another ETA member expelled from the Dominican Republic to Spain, accused of eight assassinations, says no soldier accounts for the deaths he is responsible for in war.
DIARIO 16
- ETA members facing raft of interrogations after deportations from Dominican Republic.
ABC
- Spanish sport makes history in Athens marathon.
LA VANGUARDIA
- ETA members Antxon and Macario return to Spain in hard and defiant mood.
- Waiting list for cataract operation in Catalonia is seven months.
CINCO DIAS

- In attempt to halt spiralling fuel prices and limit affect on inflation, government to adjust road law to increase space of service stations and allow installation of various adjacent stations where currently there is one.
- U.S. President Bill Clinton lowers Telefonica's tarrifs in United States.
- Doctors will have 30 percent of their salary linked to productivity.
- No law limits practice of overbooking by airlines.
EXPANSION
- Government plans tax on assets of investment funds.
- Airtel to launch on stock market in spring 1998.
- Medium-sized banks increase results by 20 percent up to June.
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Endesa managing director says Enersis could be stable member of Endesa.
- Value of euro will be known before calendar is established.
- Spanish inflation will grow by 1.9 percent this year. REUTERS
